text: Both the full-time program (all English) and part-time program (bi-lingual) last two years, aiming at cultivating forward-looking and innovative business leaders with financial expertise. More than just finance, what you get here is also a strong network of alumni to support your career. Whatever your prior profession is, SAIF paves your way towards the financial world. The faculty of SAIF's full-time Finance MBA program consists of world-class professors from top business schools. Apart from delivering you state-of-the-art financial knowledge, SAIF also builds for you a strong network of alumni to support your career. Tuition fee Students from Hong Kong, Macau and Taiwan: Full-time program: RMB 168,000 for 2 years Part-time program: RMB 238,000 for 2 years International students: Full-time & Part-time: RMB 238, 000 for 2 years Miscellaneous Expenses Books, Course Materials & Recreation: Approx.100 RMB per course Scholarship now available for international students: The Laureate Award – Full cover age of tuition fee 1 MBA student The Premium Award – Half coverage of tuition fee 2 MBA students Why choose SAIF Fiance MBA? SAIF Finance MBA program aims to help those who want to pursue a successful career in finance. Whatever your prior profession is, SAIF paves your way towards the financial world with: Worldwide gurus of finance, with expertise in both western and Chinese markets; Advanced curriculum in Finance, furthering your know-how; Virtual trading practice based on real-time stock fluctuations; A gathering of talented human capital, leads to the exchange of brilliant minds; Not Just Finance --- also covering other relevant subjects; Growing value of your degree, with the rapid growth of SAIF and Chinese financial markets; Tailor-made career service.
